verdicts.reason: A reads left to right as a banner should, with a legible headline and a clear CTA. Its flaws: the legal disclaimer sits next to the logo at near body size and competes with the message, the SUNSET SALE tag is shrunk to an unreadable sliver, a stray orange-and-white fragment floats beside the can, and the badges under the CTA are too small to read. B is just the original shrunk onto the strip: the headline, body copy, badges and CTA text are all too small to read, the tilted SUNSET SALE tag crowds the CTA, the logo is a speck, and a broken missing-image placeholder sits against the right edge.
